passages.text: Chief complaint: new headache for ten days.
History: new numbness and weakness of the left arm, which began four days ago.
Neurologic exam: cranial nerves II through XII intact. Left arm strength 4/5 with decreased sensation in the left hand. Gait normal.
Assessment: new headache with focal neurologic deficit (R51.9, R29.818). Neurologic red flag present.
Plan: order MRI brain without contrast (CPT 70551).
